topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations drive clonal succession and phenotypic transformation during early tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the role of stem cell hierarchy, the cancer stem cell hypothesis, and specific cells of origin across leukemia and intestinal cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how inflammatory signals, environmental promoters, and stromal interactions foster stem-like reprogramming and maintain tumor growth.

topics.label: Technologies for studying tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: It details the experimental, sequencing, and spatial profiling technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cell interactions in tissues.

topics.label: Synthesis of multi-factorial cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesises how genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and microenvironmental factors integrate to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and provides housekeeping for the upcoming lecture.
